interpretation: The secondary recurs near phase 0.389 and is displaced from HD 213503 in both sectors. The primary favors the target twice. The bright component has an estimated TIC radius of 37.6 solar radii and a previously published spectroscopic orbit. The eclipsing component remains uncertain.
